defects.description: legacy push-out is pure position displacement, then target_vel_w is recomputed as delta-position/dt, so realized instantaneous speed can exceed the nominal episode speed; reflection counters increment only under _bulk_eval_mode; the bounce jitter draws from the GLOBAL torch RNG conditionally on bar contacts
defects.evidence: _advance_target's bounded|physical branch ends in an unconditional return, so the entire push-out / reflection / velocity-rewrite block is structurally unreachable for E0/E1/E2 (all bounded). Verified by AST at build time.
historical: every legacy/mixed target family: density curves, density x speed map, capture/crash/timeout triples trained or evaluated under legacy dynamics
defects.note: H exists to reproduce the frozen policy's actual training lineage. Repairing D1 inside H would stop H from being that reproduction. Historical defect != evaluation implementation bug.

defects.description: bulk-eval receipt defaults target_pattern to 'static'; the simulator default is 'mixed'
defects.evidence: the 48-cell manifest sets NAVRL_TARGET_PATTERN explicitly in every cell, so the faulty default is never reached; env_state records str(self.tm.pattern) and is correct regardless
historical: any archived eval launched WITHOUT NAVRL_TARGET_PATTERN set
defects.note: inert under this preflight contract because every cell sets the variable

defects.description: general-eval receipt records target_speed_mps from NAVRL_TARGET_SPEED with default 0, but that variable maps to speed_fixed=-1 (disabled) and the real speed comes from the speed_min..speed_final curriculum
defects.evidence: the 48-cell manifest deliberately does NOT set NAVRL_TARGET_SPEED, because setting it would enable speed_fixed and CHANGE the physics. The receipt field will therefore read 0 for every arm including the moving ones.
defects.note: do NOT set NAVRL_TARGET_SPEED to fix the label: it would change physics. Treat the receipt field as meaningless and read cfg_target_speed_min/final from env_state.

defects.description: surface clearance attested as 0.0 while navrl_bars_env builds with 0.45; the drift guard recomputes the same wrong value so it can never fire
defects.evidence: the only functional consumer of placement_surface_clearance is asset_manager._footprint_clearance_xy_spacing, i.e. the footprint_clearance placement mode. Every cell uses navrl_band, which spaces by touch/gap instead.
defects.note: inert for navrl_band; would be MAJOR for a footprint_clearance lineage

defects.description: int(round(latency_s/step_dt)) turns a 0.05 s latency into 0 steps (round(0.5)==0) while env_state records 0.05 s
defects.evidence: NAVRL_DETECTION_LATENCY_S defaults to 0.0 and no cell sets it
historical: any arm configured with a latency in (0, 0.05] s
defects.note: inert at the default; a genuine bug for any future latency arm

defects.description: a non-finite LiDAR pixel maps to 1.0 = full range = 'nothing there', the most favourable value, feeding both the static-safety reward and the speed governor; the -max_range sentinel maps to the opposite meaning
defects.evidence: the LiDAR pipeline is shared by every arm; nothing about it is target-dependent
historical: every family that used this LiDAR pipeline
defects.note: arm-symmetric: it shifts absolute values but cannot bias the H-vs-E2 contrast, because every arm shares one perception stack. Do not repair mid-comparison.

defects.description: free_speed_cap_mps hard-codes sqrt(2)*2.5 while max_velocity defaults to 2.0, so at HEAD defaults the free cap exceeds the attainable norm and the governor never binds in open space
defects.evidence: every cell pins NAVRL_MAX_VELOCITY=2.5, which is the value the hard-coded cap assumes, so the cap is correct under this contract
historical: any family run at HEAD defaults rather than the v2 launcher block
defects.note: the strict gate is what keeps this inert; without it a default launch silently disables the governor

defects.description: _detector_noise_range_ar AR(1) state is never reset per episode
defects.evidence: NAVRL_DETNOISE_RANGE_STD_M and _RHO both default to 0.0 and no cell sets them
defects.note: cross-episode leak, but structurally unreachable at the default

defects.description: the LiDAR->target range correction adds the CAMERA sphere radius 0.15 to a surface range produced by a LiDAR that injects 0.20
historical: every family using LiDAR-fallback target correction
defects.note: arm-symmetric 0.05 m bias; shifts absolute range but not the contrast

type_legend.TYPE-A: historical behaviour that must be PRESERVED to reproduce arm H
type_legend.TYPE-B: current evaluation bug that INVALIDATES new measurements
type_legend.TYPE-C: receipt / provenance mislabelling only; physics unchanged
type_legend.TYPE-D: future-design debt; does not invalidate the frozen evaluation
